title: Runtime Owner Registry & Coverage-Matrix Schema
objective: Define the runtime-owner registry and the coverage-matrix schema that later SGC-02 units use to map retained mechanics, rules, loops and runtime functions without duplicating owner authority.
completion_boundaries: The owner registry contains only owner namespaces explicitly supported by the frozen SGC inputs.
A registered owner namespace does not itself prove concept coverage or implementation.
Later owner-registry extensions require exact retained-source and canonical authority evidence.
The coverage-matrix schema requires stable concept/source references, an allowed SGC disposition and evidence sufficient for that disposition.
No SGC-02B mechanics/rules/loop coverage mapping was performed.
next_action: SGC-02A is terminally complete. SGC-02B is the strict selected successor and remains selected_not_started without implementation authority.
